tools.name: delete
tools.description: Deletes the current selection. Additional optional type can be provided to filter the deletion

type.description: Type of elements to delete. Only relevant for geometry domain, when a mesh is being edited. Can be 'vertex', 'edge', 'face', 'only_faces' or 'only_edges_and_faces'

tools.name: setParentObjects
tools.description: Set parent for multiple objects

maintainWorldTransform.description: Whether to preserve world transforms after reparenting

tools.name: getChildren
tools.description: Get all children of an object

tools.name: createLight
tools.description: Create a light source (object) in the scene

width.description: Width of the light (for area lights)

height.description: Height of the light (for area lights)

tools.name: createGeometry
tools.description: Creates a new geometry object. Starting point for every geometry creation.       The geometry is built using a node graph.       The node graph output is already added in the node graph, and its id is 'Group Output'.       Its input port 'Mesh' is the output of the geometry.

tools.name: startEditGeometry
tools.description: Starts editing the geometry of an object.

tools.name: endEditGeometry
tools.description: Ends the current editing of the geometry of an object.

tools.name: addNodeMeshCube
tools.description: Adds a new mesh cube node to the current edited geometry.

tools.name: addNodeMeshCylinder
tools.description: Adds a new mesh cylinder node to the current edited geometry.

tools.name: addNodeMeshUVSphere
tools.description: Adds a new mesh sphere node to the current edited geometry.

tools.name: addNodeMeshCone
tools.description: Adds a new mesh cone node to the current edited geometry.

tools.name: addNodeSetPosition
tools.description: Adds a new set position node to the current edited geometry.

tools.name: addNodePositionInput
tools.description: Adds a new position input node to the current edited geometry.

tools.name: addNodeMath
tools.description: Adds a new math node to the current edited geometry.

tools.name: addNodeSeparateXYZ
tools.description: Adds a new separate XYZ node to the current edited geometry.

tools.name: addNodeCombineXYZ
tools.description: Adds a new combine XYZ node to the current edited geometry.

tools.name: setNodePropertyByIndex
tools.description: Sets an input default value of a node. For the available inputs and their type, use 'getNodeInputsOutputs'. Note that vectors are written Vector(x, y, z)

propertyIndex.description: Index of the property in the list of inputs

tools.name: getNodeTypes
tools.description: Returns all available node types that can be added to a geometry

tools.name: getNodeInputsOutputs
tools.description: Retrieves all input and output socket names for a node, and checks if input sockets can accept a default_value.

nodeId.description: The node id to get information about, must exist in the node graph

tools.name: addNodesBatch
tools.description: Adds a batch of nodes to the current edited geometry. The nodes are added in the order they are provided.       the node format is {"type": <node_type>, "inputs": {<input_name>: <value>, ...}}

Center.description: Point to rotate around. Type : Vector

Find.description: The string to find in the input string. Type : String

Replace.description: The string to replace each match with. Type : String

Path.description: Path to a STL file. Type : String

Points.description: Points to instance on. Type : Geometry

Rotate.description: Rotate islands for best fit. Type : Bool

Background.description: Value for voxels outside of the cube. Type : Float

tools.name: connectNodesBatch
tools.description: Connects a batch of nodes in the current edited geometry. The connections are made in the order they are provided.

tools.name: getCameraView
tools.description: Get a customizable view of the 3D scene from any camera angle.

shading_mode.description: Rendering style for the viewport (WIREFRAME: line rendering, SOLID: basic shading, MATERIAL: with materials, RENDERED: fully rendered)

name_visibility_predicate.description: Python lambda function that takes an object as input and returns display settings (e.g., 'lambda obj: {"show_name": obj.type == "MESH"}')

auto_adjust_camera.description: When true, automatically positions the camera to frame all scene objects

perspective.description: Predefined view angle (TOP/FRONT/RIGHT/PERSP) or custom camera configuration

tools.name: getSceneGraph
tools.description: Get the scene graph of the current scene.
